title: Designer Brand Edward Crutchley X CLO Promotional Campaign
description: High energy ahead! Stunning advertisement warning!!
transcript:
Clow is an incredibly intuitive design tool that allowed me to advance the design of my spring-summer collection in the most incredible way.  
It enabled me to take the roughest sketches and, through 2D pattern drafting, truly explore the shapes and fits I wanted to create.  
A truly revolutionary stage for me was taking these flat garment shapes and being able to digitally sew and drape them into a 3D rendering.  
Within minutes, you can see a 3D image of what you're designing and make alterations on those small decisions that make a design special.  
Also, being able to view the same garment simulated in different materials and different patterns.  
Then seeing how those choices alter the drape, look, and spirit of a garment was truly revolutionary.  
A truly revolutionary stage for me was taking these flat garment shapes and being able to digitally sew and drape them into a 3D rendering.  
Also, being able to look at the shapes and patterns of the fabric, consider the details, and really create a 3D style to then be able to create something that I want to make from it.  
I was able to do this with the help of my friend at the Sunlight Studio.  
Up next...  
Thank you for watching.  
Thank you for watching.

chunks.content: ## Overview of CLO Design Tool in Fashion Design This section explains how CLO, an intuitive digital design tool, enhances the fashion design process through 2D pattern drafting and 3D garment simulation. Key terms include 2D pattern drafting, 3D rendering, digital sewing, drape simulation, and fabric pattern visualization. ## Advancing Design with CLO: From Sketches to 3D Garments CLO enabled the transformation of rough sketches into detailed designs by allowing precise 2D pattern drafting. This process helped explore garment shapes and fits more thoroughly than traditional methods. A revolutionary feature is the ability to digitally sew and drape flat garment patterns into 3D renderings within minutes. This immediate visualization allows designers to assess and adjust subtle design decisions that significantly impact the final product. ## Material and Pattern Simulation for Enhanced Garment Visualization CLO offers simulation of the same garment in various materials and fabric patterns. This functionality lets designers observe how different textiles influence the garment's drape, appearance, and overall aesthetic, providing valuable insights into material selection and design impact. ## Collaborative Workflow and Studio Support The designer utilized assistance from a collaborator at Sunlight Studio, indicating that CLO supports collaborative workflows and professional studio environments, enhancing the creative and technical process in fashion design.
